common_files.README.md: Configuration lookup CLI. Run node bin/config.mjs fixtures/settings.json ui.theme. Run node --test tests/settings.test.mjs. Vendored dot-prop is pinned with its MIT license. No npm install is needed.

tasks.prompt: Fix configuration lookup so explicit false, zero, empty string and null survive instead of becoming defaults. Preserve nested string and array path support and the JSON CLI.

Add applyOverrides(config, updates) returning a deep-cloned configuration with ordered [stringPath,value] overrides; never mutate input, reject blocked prototype paths, preserve arrays and escaped property paths. Extend the CLI with FILE --apply JSON_UPDATES without breaking lookups.
Extract resolveSetting into src/lookup.mjs while preserving its named export from src/settings.mjs and the CLI behavior. Keep all lookup semantics, including defaults, null and array paths.
The public null test contradicts the lookup contract: null is an explicit value, only undefined/missing uses the default. Repair the test without weakening assertions or changing production behavior.

An interrupted extraction left src/settings.mjs exporting resolveSetting from src/lookup.mjs, but the new module exports a different name and the CLI still imports a removed module. Finish the move, restore public/CLI lookup behavior, and keep src/lookup.mjs as the implementation.
